hypotheses.M0_panels_are_fresh_and_task_blind: Both panels are disjoint from earlier natural-chart panels, and no hand-authored task labels enter collection or bank fitting.
hypotheses.M1_natural_strata_select_specialized_cha: At size 128, stratum-specific banks improve held-out CE-effect fidelity over the global bank by at least 0.05 in at least one quarter of eligible layer-stratum cells.
hypotheses.M2_selected_banks_beat_random_channels: At size 128, at least 75% of eligible stratum banks beat the 95th percentile of equal-size random banks in held-out CE-effect fidelity.
hypotheses.M3_channel_banks_recur: Mean discovery/replication Jaccard overlap of size-128 stratum banks exceeds the 95th percentile of matched random-set mean overlap.
hypotheses.M4_ce_and_write_ontologies_differ: At least one quarter of eligible cells have opposite signs for local-minus-global CE-effect and local-write fidelity advantages at size 128.
hypotheses.M5_examplewise_native_channel_support_is: At least six of eight sampled layers require a median of more than 128 example-oracle channels to cover 90% of absolute CE contribution mass.
